title: A fantastic evening of tapas and great company
text:
I booked the tapas tour through GetYourGuide, and the whole process was really easy. They kept me updated and well informed throughout.

Our guide, Jeff, was fantastic – fun, extremely knowledgeable and full of interesting information. We had a brilliant evening, and the group got on so well that we even went for a few more drinks together afterwards!

I would highly recommend this tour.
author: V8029BPmichelep

title: Highly Recommend - Gracias Jeffery!!
text:
Jeffery gave us a fun and educational evening introducing us to the complex food history of Seville. At every stop, we were welcomed by staff eager to share what made their food so special. After spending the evening with Jeffery, it was easy to see why the restaurant staff were always so happy to see him with his group in tow.

He was gracious, friendly, and thoughtfully answered every question we had, and had more to share that we wouldn’t have known to ask. We were able to relax and enjoy the experience because he emailed us a recap of our night and recommendations for the rest of our trip.
author: alissam526

title: Must do in Sevilla
text: Great way to get to know a new city. Our tour guide Jeff gave great commentary about the food and the history of Sevilla.    We ate good and laughed a lots. We made new friends and wonderful memories.
author: Julia_T

title: Seville’s best food tasting tour
text: I had an amazing time on my food tour in Seville! Our guide, Jason, was fantastic—super knowledgeable, friendly, and passionate about the local culinary scene. He took us to some incredible hidden gems that I never would have found on my own, and every single tapas stop was delicious. Between the great food, local wine, and Jason's fun stories about Seville's history, it was easily one of the highlights of my trip. Highly recommend
author: robdD1969QR

title: Fun evening
text: We had a lovely evening sampling tapas dishes and accompanying drinks across the town. Rosie our guide was everything you would want in a host, hospitable and knowledgeable. We had a great group which helped and we stuck around a bit longer for a chat when it ended.
author: Danmer23

title: First night Tapas tour
text:
Booked as a first night activity in Seville and we were glad we did. 
It’s generally not the kind of thing we do. 
Anna our guide was fantastic. Very knowledgeable and very enthusiastic. 
We were taken around side streets that were far from the main tourist areas and taken to bars that we would likely have walked straight past. 
There was plenty of great tapas offered with a drink at each of the four stops, Anna given background information and recommendations as we when. 
All in all I thought it was great value 
for money and certainly recommend it.
author: siwni

title: Wow.  Just wow.
text: A brilliant night.  Our guide Ferran arranged a variety of historically significant and tasty tapas paired with traditional drinks.  Every location was different and wonderful.   Cannot recommend this tour enough.   If you’re lucky enough to have Ferran as your host, it will be amazing.
